plugin.description: Plugin to use; only 'live' is currently supported per documentation.

use_expert.description: If true, set DEBIAN_PRIORITY=low to enable expert mode.

enforce_text.description: If true, set DEBIAN_FRONTEND=text to enforce text frontend.

plugin_options.description: Additional plugin-specific command-line arguments (e.g., '--keymap=us'). Each item must be a single-argument string or an option with its value as one list entry per man page style: '--opt value' → ['--opt', 'value'] is invalid; each list element must be one token. Per man page, only --expert and --text are documented high-level options; others are passed through.
